skill.name: quady3d
skill.description: Create and deliver 3D assets through the Quady3D MCP tools, including text or selected-image generation, task recovery, and saving model files to a project. Use when the user wants a real 3D asset or help with a Quady3D task.
skill.summary: Generate 3D assets through Quady3D MCP, recover existing tasks, and save model files within authorized project directories.
skill.author: quady3dai

finding_verdicts.reason: The paragraph describes host verification, authorized spending, and scoped uninstallation. It does not instruct system enumeration or collection of machine information.
QUADY3D_API_KEY is an environment variable name, not an embedded secret. The guidance requires secure host configuration and explicitly excludes credentials from chat.
The workspace status reports configured project roots and readiness for a paid generation. This is a scoped prerequisite check, not broad system reconnaissance.
Backticks format the quady3d_ tool prefix in Markdown. The instruction requests tool discovery and prohibits invented endpoints or credentials in chat.
Backticks identify documented model-listing and account-query MCP tools. These read-only capability checks contain no shell command or executable backtick expression.
Backticks label parameter_schema and allOf fields in prose. The instructions validate supported generation settings rather than executing external commands.
Backticks label workspace readiness fields. The paragraph restricts output to configured ready roots and contains no shell execution.
The backticked local_recovery.across_keys value is an MCP status field. Recovery remains tied to the authenticated account and API with server ownership checks.
Backticks identify the image-upload MCP tool, not a shell command. Uploads are limited to the user-selected image within an allowed project root.
Backticks format the quady3d_quote MCP tool name. The paragraph documents quote validity and download-access checks without any shell invocation.
Backticks identify the job-creation tool and request fields. Creation uses the user's authorized credit limit and a stable action identity, not shell execution.
Backticks label job-query tools and the wait_seconds argument in Markdown. The paragraph preserves existing task identity and prohibits unauthorized replacement generations.
Backticks identify the asset-download MCP tool. File delivery stays within the requested project scope and explicitly preserves existing files.
The URL is homepage metadata for the named product. It is not an execution instruction or a destination for credentials or project data.
The product setup URL is a documentation hyperlink. No data upload, credential transmission, or automatic network request is specified by this link.
The line discusses retry identity, job queries, and bounded waiting. It does not import a configuration library or access environment variables.

content.value_statement: Generating a 3D asset requires coordinating inputs, credit limits, task status, and file delivery. This skill guides Quady3D MCP workflows from authorized generation through recovery and project download.
actual_capabilities: Query available models, parameter schemas, account limits, download access, and workspace readiness through Quady3D MCP.
Prepare text input or upload one user-selected PNG, JPG, or WebP image up to 8 MiB.
Request generation quotes and submit jobs using authorized credit limits and stable action identifiers.
Recover interrupted submissions and query existing jobs without silently creating replacement generations.
Download returned assets to authorized project paths while preserving existing files.
Report saved paths, formats, sizes, and validation limits for delivered assets.
limitations: Requires a separately installed Quady3D MCP server, Node.js 22 or later, credentials, credits, and appropriate download access.
Only the documented standalone Codex workflow has been verified; Claude support remains unverified.
Generation options depend on callable model capabilities; the skill does not independently provide rigging, animation, multiview generation, or editing.
A downloaded model is not guaranteed to be printable, topologically sound, or compatible with project materials.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Game Prop
use_cases.description: Generate a single prop from text, save it into the game project, and check supported material, scale, and geometry requirements.

use_cases.title: Generate from a Selected Image
use_cases.description: Upload an approved reference image, inspect model options, and generate a downloadable asset within an authorized credit limit.

use_cases.title: Recover an Interrupted Delivery
use_cases.description: Find the original task, check its status, and retry asset delivery without starting a replacement generation.

prompt_templates.title: Check Connection Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Quady3D tools, account access, available text-generation models, and workspace readiness for [project directory]. Do not create a paid task.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Text-Based Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate one [object description] for [intended use] in [project directory]. Keep spending within [maximum credits] and report the saved asset details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: create an asset from a written description.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Selected Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use only [selected image path] to generate a 3D asset in [project directory] within [maximum credits]. Validate supported settings before quoting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: generate from a user-approved image.

prompt_templates.title: Recover and Integrate an Existing Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Recover [job or action ID] without creating a replacement. Download its successful asset into [project directory] and validate integration with the existing asset loader.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover a task and verify project integration.

best_practices: Keep API keys in secure host settings and restrict allowed roots to the intended project directories.
Check model schemas, workspace readiness, download access, and authorized credit limits before creating a paid task.
Preserve action, quote, job, and asset identifiers so interruptions can be recovered without duplicate generation.
anti_patterns: Creating replacement generations after timeouts, stopped waits, or download failures without resolving the original task.
Uploading unselected files, broadening project roots, or exposing credentials in conversation or project files.
Claiming printability, rendering success, or advanced model features without relevant inspection and callable capabilities.

faq.question: Does installing this skill provide the Quady3D service?
faq.answer: No. Install the Quady3D MCP server separately and configure an account with credentials, credits, and appropriate download access.

faq.question: Which AI hosts have been verified?
faq.answer: The source documents verification only for the standalone Codex workflow. Claude remains pending verification.

faq.question: What image inputs are supported?
faq.answer: The documented first release accepts one user-selected PNG, JPG, or WebP image up to 8 MiB within an allowed project root.

faq.question: When are generation charges incurred?
faq.answer: Quoting and staging images do not incur generation charges. Job creation uses the quoted request and the user's authorized credit limit.

faq.question: What happens when a generation request times out?
faq.answer: Recover the original action or query its known job ID. A timeout does not authorize a replacement generation.

faq.question: Are downloaded assets ready for printing or game use?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Check project integration, materials, scale, and geometry separately; printing also requires units, dimensions, and slicing validation.
